newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian LNG appoints new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian LNG appoints new chief executive.

text.p: The Nigerian liquefied natural gas (NLNG) company on Thursday named the Briton Steve Ollereanshaw as its new chief executive.
"Mr Ollerenshaw succeds the outgoing Dutch managing director Theo Oerlemans, effective from February 28," the company said in statement in Lagos.

Ollereanshaw, a Cambridge university economics graduate, is currently the general manager of the Western Division of the Shell Petroleum Development Company in midwestern Warri town, the statement added.
It said Oerlemans had completed his three-year term and was returning to London where he would be director of Shell International Gas Limited.
NLNG is constructing in southeastern Bonny town the $4 billion LNG project, which is expected to produce 7.2 billion cubic metres of gas per year from 1999.
